assumptions.choice: Check self.data.datetime.time(0) for hour 13 and minute 10
assumptions.reason: The specification states to open a short position at 13:10 UTC. Matching the bar timestamp time directly to 13:10 aligns with the feed's time output.

assumptions.choice: Initialize highest_price on position fill and update with bar High while position is open
assumptions.reason: The spec defines the trailing stop level as the maximum price reached since trailing stop activation minus 0.19. Tracking the bar High captures the maximum price reached during the position's life.

assumptions.choice: Issue self.close() when the bar Low reaches or crosses below the calculated stop_level
assumptions.reason: The spec specifies that the position must be automatically closed when the asset price reaches the trailing stop level (max price - 0.19). Using self.close() adheres to canonical default #2 for exiting positions.
